verdict.rationale: Moving files and settings from an old computer is a fair question for a desktop OS, so the axis applies. The pack only covers installing Ubuntu in place of or alongside Windows, creating a bootable USB, and BitLocker/RST preparation. None of that is a migration tool or documented procedure for bringing files and settings over from another machine.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can transfer my files and settings from my old computer to a new machine running the OS
